# Dust (ambient particle layers)

**Object:** `Custom_1114_Dust.xml` dialog `1114` (persistent, zorder 0, generated by `gen_dust46.py` — do not hand edit) · `Includes_Dust3.xml` (album/poster lit dust, spin) · menu dust under MM (`BzMMDustA`)  
**Last updated:** 2026-10-31 · 5.33.194 (new file, catch-up sync)  
**Status:** draft — matches live 5.33.194 tuner rows; not Rob-approved

## What it is
Dust 2.0: dialog 1114 opens right after the splash and stays open across window switches so the drift never restarts. Layers are clipped to the black void of the current screen mode; a black feather softens edges by the colour block / art / mini-player. Three void layers (Distant, Mid, Ambient spin) + Menu dust (MM open) + album/poster lit dust (Dust3).

## Keys / touch
None — decorative, never focusable.

## Tuner rows (BEZEL Tuner › DUST, `bz_tune.json`)
| Row id | Layer | Options | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| d20fdens / d20mdens / d20sdens | Distant / Mid / Spin density | Low · Med · High | Med / Low / Med |
| d20fsize / d20msize / d20ssize / mmdsize | Distant / Mid / Spin / Menu **particle size** | **90% · 100% · 125%** | 90 / 90 / 100 / 90 % |
| d20fbri / d20mbri / d20sbri, mmdbright | Opacity | 10%–100% in 10 steps (no 0%) | see skin-settings-tuner.md |
| d20ffade / d20mfade / d20sfade / mmdfade | Twinkle fade | Off · Slow · Mid · Fast · Faster | Mid / Slow / Slow / Mid |
| d20fslide / d20mslide / mmdslide | Drift slide | Off · Slow · Mid · Fast · Faster | Fast / Slow / Mid |
| d3dens, d3lsize, d3asize, d3amb, d3lit, d3glow, d3goff, spinspd, lspinspd, d3speed | Album Dust3 (lit, ambient, glow, spin) | various | per json |
| pd3lit, pd3lsize, plspinspd, pfibamt, pflkamt, pdust | Poster Dust3 | various | per json |
| sdsize, sdbright, fibamt, flkamt, breathe, glow0–4 | Extra sparkle/fibre/flake/breathe | various | per json |
Presets (`bz_tune.py` `dust`: subtle / mid / …) set density, size, brightness, fade, slide together.
